prompts: The package {WS}/arena_ecs has failing tests in {WS}/tests. Find the root cause and fix the code (do not change the tests). Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests` with cwd {WS}. Python standard library only. Write your files inside {WS}. Do not ask for confirmation; finish the task and summarize in 2 lines.
answers:
Root cause: two copy-paste typos. `movement_system` advanced y with `vel.x` (arena_ecs/systems/movement.py:5), and `overlaps` compared `pa.y + ba.h > pa.y` instead of `> pb.y` (arena_ecs/systems/collision.py:7), so that condition was always true and any x-overlapping pair reported a hit.
Fix: use `vel.y * dt` and `pb.y`; `python -m unittest discover -s tests` now reports "Ran 2 tests ... OK" (both tests pass, tests untouched).
